title.purpose: Heading of the tag vocabulary screen. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

empty.purpose: Says the vocabulary is empty and how to start. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
empty.where: Tags screen, in place of the list.

cancel.purpose: Button that closes a rename form without changing anything. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
cancel.where: Tags screen, beside a rename form's confirm button.

trackCount_zero.purpose: Says no track has this tag. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
trackCount_zero.where: Tags screen, next to a tag's name.

trackCount_one.purpose: Says one track has this tag. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
trackCount_one.where: Tags screen, next to a tag's name.

trackCount_other.purpose: Says how many tracks have this tag. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
trackCount_other.where: Tags screen, next to a tag's name.

goneFromRekordbox.purpose: Marks a tag copied from a My Tag that rekordbox no longer has. The tag stays. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
goneFromRekordbox.where: Tags screen, next to a tag's name.

colour.label.purpose: Names the colour choice of a group or tag for screen readers. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
colour.label.where: Tags screen, the colour drop-down beside a group or tag (not shown).

colour.default.purpose: The colour choice that clears a colour. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
colour.default.where: Tags screen, the colour drop-down of a group or tag.

showTracks.action.purpose: Link that opens the Library with only the tracks that have this tag. (PROPOSED, 3C-F)

showTracks.for.purpose: Spoken name of the Show tracks link, which says which tag ({{name}} is the tag's name). (PROPOSED, 3C-F)
showTracks.for.where: Tags screen, beside a tag; read by screen readers only.

rename.action.purpose: Button that starts renaming a group or tag. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
rename.action.where: Tags screen, beside a group or tag.

rename.label.purpose: Names the box a group or tag is renamed in. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

rename.confirm.purpose: Button that saves the new name. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
rename.confirm.where: Tags screen, beside the rename box.

group.empty.purpose: Says a group has no tags. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
group.empty.where: Tags screen, under a group's name.

newGroup.label.purpose: Names the box a new group is named in. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
newGroup.label.where: Tags screen, below the last group.

newGroup.action.where: Tags screen, beside the new group box.

newTag.label.purpose: Names the box a new tag is named in. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
newTag.label.where: Tags screen, under a group's tags.

newTag.action.where: Tags screen, beside the new tag box.

import.action.purpose: Button that copies rekordbox's My Tags into the vocabulary as tags. One step to undo. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

import.group.purpose: Name of the group the copied tags go in the first time. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
import.group.where: Becomes a group's name when the first copy is made.

import.nothing.purpose: Says copying from rekordbox changed nothing. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
import.nothing.where: Tags screen, under the page heading after copying.

import.done.purpose: Says what copying from rekordbox did. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
import.done.where: Tags screen, under the page heading after copying.

track.title.purpose: Heading of the tag buttons in a track's details. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
track.title.where: Details panel, between the crates and the withdraw line.

track.none.purpose: Says there are no tags to give the track. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
track.none.where: Details panel, under the Tags heading.

picker.search.purpose: Names and prompts the picker's search box. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

picker.list.purpose: Names the picker's list for screen readers. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

picker.trackCount_one.purpose: Says how many tracks the picked tag goes to. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

picker.trackCount_other.purpose: Says how many tracks the picked tag goes to. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

picker.empty.purpose: Says there are no tags to pick. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
picker.empty.where: Tag picker, in place of the list.

picker.none.purpose: Says nothing matches what was typed. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
picker.none.where: Tag picker, in place of the list.

error.groupNotFound.purpose: Error: the group was not found. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

error.tagNotFound.purpose: Error: the tag was not found. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)

error.nameEmpty.where: Wherever a tag or group is named.

error.nameTaken.purpose: Error: another tag or group has this name. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
error.nameTaken.where: Wherever a tag or group is named.

error.nameUnsendable.purpose: Error: the tag name can't be written to rekordbox as a playlist name. (PROPOSED, 3A-T)
